title: NVIDIA developers integrate frontier AI models with Omniverse libraries
excerpt: Developers are using AI agents and NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications for testing robotics and autonomous systems.
bodyHtml:
NVIDIA announced on October 8, 2026, that developers are utilizing frontier AI models alongside NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to create simulation applications. These tools allow users to build environments for exploring scenarios, investigating failures, and improving designs through natural-language instructions.

The integration process involves connecting Omniverse libraries, which provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering, and sensor simulation capabilities. Developers direct AI agents to generate code and manage assets, such as creating interactive warehouse simulators or testing autonomous-driving workflows. For example, NVIDIA staff used agents to build digital twins and test robotic skills, such as humanoid movements in a simulated Robo Olympics project.

The workflow enables developers to compare simulated sensor outputs with recorded data to refine scenes. According to NVIDIA, these projects demonstrate how AI agents can assist in configuring physical scenes and validating robot performance within simulation environments.
topic: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
